title: בר חבו

paragraphs: Bar Chavu, a writer of tefillin in Abaye’s time. Berakhot 53b: Abaye would recite the blessing over the light at the house of Bar Chavu. In Bava Metzia 29b: tefillin are readily available at the house of Bar Chavu. In Megillah 18b: Abaye permitted the house of Bar Chavu to write tefillin without copying from a written text. There is also Adda bar Chavu.
